stem: While reviewing the prescription, a pharmacist seeks to enter a collaborative practice agreement. Select all threshold qualifications supported by statute.

choices.text: At this stage, maintain the required Massachusetts license and professional-liability coverage.
Given the described event, meet the degree-or-experience and additional annual CE requirements.
For this scenario, no written agreement is needed after five years of practice.
On this record, the additional annual continuing education must relate to the pharmacist's collaborative practice area.
Under these facts, technician registration satisfies the pharmacist-license requirement.
